objective: Establish whether the learner can retrieve an expression without support and use it under a changed condition. Independent recall is necessary evidence for mastery, not sufficient on its own.

evidence.claim: Retrieval practice produces better long-term retention than restudying.
Testing effect with feedback reaches g about 0.73; without feedback about 0.50.
Testing effect g about 0.61 across 188 experiments.
Variation questions are necessary to detect formulaic chunking.
evidence.citation: based on formulaic-sequence observation; no direct AI-coach evidence

evidence.claim: Independent recall is the sole criterion of mastery.
evidence.citation: Original text asserts this. It conflicts with the five-dimension evidence model and with the retention literature, which distinguishes acquisition from retention.

corrections.from: 这是'掌握'的唯一判定口径
corrections.to: 独立提取是掌握的必要证据，不是唯一口径。mastered 需同时满足：E1 独立冷提取 + (E2 单变量变式 或 E3 场景迁移) + E4 延迟保持；且证据集中不得含模仿或 STT 识别。
corrections.reason: 单一时间点的独立产出无法区分'记住了'与'刚在短时记忆里'。原文自己的边界案例承认'间隔不足 10 分钟就做 R1，通过无意义'，却又把 R1 写成唯一口径，自相矛盾。保留'唯一'会让一次性表演被记为长期掌握。

corrections.from: R1 与 R2 都通过才算 mastered
corrections.to: 改为证据门槛：E1 + (E2|E3) + E4。仅 E1+E2 记为 FLEXIBLE（可用但不稳定），不记 mastered。
corrections.reason: R1+R2 都在同一次会话内时可全部落在短时记忆窗口，仍不足以称掌握。

corrections.to: 10 分钟为'可计入保持证据'的下限；低于下限仍可测，但结果只能记 PRACTICE，不得进入 E4。跨会话 ≥24 小时才是 E4 的完整证据。
corrections.reason: 把 10 分钟写成硬拦截会让首次课内复习无法进行；写成'不计证据'既保留测量，又不污染掌握判定。

corrections.from: 变式只换名词（假变式，应为句法结构或语用功能的变化）
corrections.to: 明确单变量轴枚举：QUANTITY | POLARITY | TIME | LOCATION | INTERLOCUTOR | REGISTER | MODALITY。每次变式只动一轴；同一轴重复 3 次以上视为刷题。
corrections.reason: 原文只给了'不许换名词'的反例，没有给出可判定的轴列表，无法机器校验。

masteryModel.note: Mastery is a state derived from accumulated evidence, not from a single turn outcome.

evidenceTypes.name: INDEPENDENT_COLD_PRODUCTION
evidenceTypes.definition: Target produced with no hint and no full model before the attempt.

evidenceTypes.name: VARIATION_SINGLE_VARIABLE
evidenceTypes.definition: Same structure produced under exactly one changed variable.

evidenceTypes.name: TRANSFER_NEW_SCENARIO
evidenceTypes.definition: Structure reused in a different scene with a different interlocutor.

evidenceTypes.name: DELAYED_RETENTION
evidenceTypes.definition: E1 reproduced after >= 10 minutes (partial) or across sessions >= 24h (full).

evidenceTypes.name: SCAFFOLDED_SUCCESS
evidenceTypes.definition: Produced only after a hint or full model.

evidenceTypes.name: IMITATION
evidenceTypes.definition: Repetition of a model delivered immediately before.

evidenceTypes.name: STT_RECOGNITION
evidenceTypes.note: recognition is not production and is not pronunciation assessment

stateLadder.requires: E5 or E6 present, no E1
E5 present and at least one attempt
E1 and (E2 or E3), no E4
E1 and (E2 or E3) and E4
previously RETAINED and E1 now fails

hardGuards: A single STT success can never produce mastered.
Hearing the target, or recognising its meaning, can never produce mastered.
A turn in which the full answer was given before the attempt can never produce E1.
A technical failure (ASR error, network, model error) produces NO evidence and never a penalty.

masteryLevelCompatibility.problem: The current runtime raises mastery_level by 2 on any STT pass and by 1 on a correct comprehension item, with no down-path. One successful repetition therefore crosses the review threshold (mastery_level < 2) permanently.
deltaRules: STT pass alone: +0. It may create E1 only if producedIndependently and no full model preceded it; E1 alone reaches level 3, never 4.
Comprehension correct: +0 toward mastery. It is a comprehension signal, not a production signal.
Skip: +0. Skipping is not evidence of anything.
Decay: -1 when a previously RETAINED item fails E1 on a later session.
masteryLevelCompatibility.blockingNote: This mapping cannot be implemented without changing runtime behaviour. It is recorded here as a requirement, not applied to any code by this deliverable.
